description: This file defines the UriFactory class implementing UriFactoryInterface, providing methods to create URI objects from strings and environment globals within the Slim Framework's PSR-7 implementation.

classes.name: UriFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating Uri objects from strings or server environment globals.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates a UriInterface object from a URI string, parsing its components.

methods.name: createFromGlobals
methods.description: Creates a Uri object based on server environment variables, such as HTTPS status, host, port, and request URI.
